name: connector-sdk-intellisense
description: Provides IntelliSense, completions, and dynamic value suggestions for the Azure Connectors SDK.

connectorSdk.sdkNupkgPath.markdownDescription: **Deprecated:** Use `connectorSdk.sdkPath` instead. Path to the Connector SDK .nupkg file.

connectorSdk.sdkPath.description: Path to the Connector SDK .nupkg or .dll file. If empty, the extension discovers the SDK from workspace project NuGet references, then checks for an SDK/ folder in the workspace, and finally looks for a sibling repo build output.

connectorSdk.lspServerPath.description: Path to the LSP server DLL (SdkLspServer.dll). If empty, uses the bundled server.

connectorSdk.azure.subscriptionId.description: Azure subscription ID for dynamic value resolution.

connectorSdk.azure.resourceGroup.description: Azure resource group for dynamic value resolution.

connectorSdk.azure.bearerToken.description: Optional: explicit Azure bearer token for dynamic value resolution. If empty, the server acquires tokens automatically via DefaultAzureCredential (az login).

connectorSdk.connectionsFilePath.description: Path to connections.json or local.settings.json. If empty, auto-detected from workspace.
